text.en:
Section 7, classification (m), (n) and (o) of Republic Act No. 4136, is hereby amended to read as
(m) Government automobiles; (n) government trucks; and (o) government motorcycles. Motor vehicles owned
by the Government of the Philippines or any of its political subdivisions and those belonging to the
government-owned and/or controlled corporations shall be registered under this classification although the
latter may under their respective charters pay registration fees.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
